name: sjsyrek
description: Personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins by Steven Syrek.

plugins.name: design-council
plugins.description: Convene parallel role-specialized peer agents (dynamic roster, plan card first) to debate a cross-domain decision or audit a codebase in real time. Invoking Claude acts as CEO: convenes, routes peer-DMs, arbitrates deadlocks, writes a one-page decision log.

plugins.name: red-team
plugins.description: Adversarial security and robustness review. Spawn independent specialist attacker agents to find every way to break an application — vulnerabilities, logic flaws, race conditions, dependency risks, infrastructure misconfigs. The Incident Commander cross-correlates findings to surface compound risks no single agent would catch.

plugins.name: compliance-panel
plugins.description: Multi-agent EU digital compliance review covering GDPR, e-Privacy, NIS2, EU AI Act, and the Data Act. The Panel Chair spawns independent specialist assessor agents and cross-correlates findings into a prioritised gap report with concrete remediation steps.

plugins.name: context-cleaning-crew
plugins.description: Audit a Claude Code setup for context cost, duplicates, stale memory, conflicting instructions, removed tools, version drift and plaintext secrets, then clean it up with per-item approval. Quick, full (five reviewer seats) and read-only report modes. Needs python3.

plugins.name: accessibility-board
plugins.description: Review a product's UI against all 55 WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA criteria. A guarded single-page scan (axe-core, keyboard walk, zoom and text spacing) and five independent read-only auditor seats feed one criterion-mapped report with compound findings. Full mode needs Node 22.12+.
